chapters.label: Live: Cali 2016
chapters.text: The 2016 Futsal World Cup quarter-final, in Cali. Russia lead Spain five two. Spain attack with a flying keeper, so their goal is empty. Gustavo, Russia’s goleiro, strikes from his own end. Goal! Six two!

chapters.label: Replay: from the empty goal
chapters.text: Watch again, from inside the empty goal. The ball travels the whole court, all the way in!

chapters.label: How he commands
chapters.text: How does a goleiro command? He sees the whole court, so he talks. Left! Mark him! Step up! Short, loud words move his team.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn. Shout clear instructions, so your teammates know where to be.
